title: Query budget
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\tau\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$. Define the query budget as $n$ times twice the active cap at threshold $\tau$, times twice the Fourier-estimator sample count at the weight-accuracy and call-confidence parameters specified by $n$ and $\tau$.
caveat: The active-cap, accuracy, confidence, and sample-count functions are referenced but not defined in the supplied definitions.
